name: CSPC Pharmaceutical Group Limited
summary: CSPC Pharmaceutical Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical products in Mainland China, other Asian regions, Europe, North America, and internationally. It operates through Finished Drugs, Bulk Products, and Functional Food and Others segments.
